verdict.rationale: Morph explicitly documents an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (and Anthropic Messages compatibility) plus first-class provider-switching workflows—canary traffic splits and full migration from OpenAI/Anthropic to another model—showing the standard API enables mid-workflow provider switches without code changes. Community evidence (morph-comm-5) independently confirms the OpenAI-compatible endpoint works with third-party tools. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the canary/migration switching feature itself (only vendor docs), and no evidence of switching away from Morph to another provider.
